title: GIGAWATT-BLOCKS personality
description: One file per personality. Switching personality changes only these custom properties and four variant flags; no block markup is personality-aware. Reference: previews/design-system.md

name.description: Filename stem; what globals/settings.json personality names

for.description: The kind of business this suits — lead-gen 03_profile matches against this line

fonts.description: Two typefaces, never more. CSS font-family stacks; files self-hosted in src/design/fonts/

flags.description: The four variant flags. Block variant defaults when content doesn't set one; also data-* attributes on <html> for CSS

tokens.description: Optional overrides of tokens.css values, keyed by custom property name (e.g. "--gw-radius-md": "0px")

composition.description: Default homepage composition, in order: "Block" or "Block:variant" (e.g. "CardGrid:services")
